snapshot.meaning: Placeholder structure used to build the Tathya world. Not a real database read. A committed read-only export from the Tathya repository replaces this file, and the gate refuses to pass, before the world is published.

silentFailure.explanation: Its collection jobs stopped returning useful errors and it dropped out of the visible record. Failure state is shown as workflow state, not hidden behind an eligibility flag.

corpusBenchmark.reason: No repeatable corpus export with source, duplicate, freshness and unresolved-record denominators exists yet, so no corpus size or clustering score is shown anywhere in this world.
